result.task: Find a recipe for a vegan pumpkin pie on Allrecipes with a minimum four-star rating and a total cook time exceeding 1 hour.
result.final_answer:
I found a recipe that meets all your criteria on Allrecipes.

## 🍰 Recipe: **Amazing Vegan Pumpkin Pie**

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| **Rating** | ⭐ 5.0 stars (from 1 rating) |
| **Cook Time** | 1 hr 55 mins |
| **Total Time** | 3 hrs 35 mins (215 minutes) — **exceeds 1 hour** ✅ |
| **Yield** | 3 (9-inch) pies |
| **Servings** | 24 |
| **Submitted by** | autumn |
| **Updated** | March 1, 2025 |

**URL:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/255508/amazing-vegan-pumpkin-pie/

### Why this matches all your criteria
1. ✅ **Vegan pumpkin pie** — A modification of the author's mother's from-scratch pumpkin pie recipe, made vegan for friends.
2. ✅ **Minimum 4-star rating** — Holds a perfect **5.0 stars**.
3. ✅ **Total cook time exceeds 1 hour** — Cook Time alone is 1 hr 55 mins; Total Time is 3 hrs 35 mins (the additional 1 hr 20 mins accounts for chilling/setting time after baking).

### Other vegan pumpkin pie recipes I surveyed (didn't meet all criteria)
- "Vegan Pumpkin Pie" — only 3.7 stars ❌
- "Vegan Pumpkin Pie Blondies" — 4.5 stars but it's a blondie, not a pie
- "Tofu Pumpkin Pie" — 4.5 stars (this would also be a candidate worth checking)
- "Vegan Pumpkin Pie Smoothie" — 4.5 stars but it's a smoothie, not a pie

The **Amazing Vegan Pumpkin Pie** is the best direct match to your request — it is clearly a vegan pie, has a 5-star rating, and a total time well over an hour.
